_doc: The 3D dungeon prototype (0.139, dungeon-lab/ + src/explore/): a corridor to walk with WASD / arrows and mouselook. Distances in metres. gen = the floor generator (mapgen.js, sizes in cells; a linear chain since 0.143): width x height, rooms of roomMin..roomMax cells a side (the boss chamber bossSize), roomGap cells of rock between rooms, linkMin..linkMax = corridor length from one room to the next, straightness = chance the chain keeps its heading, `encounters` combat rooms (+ start, shrine, boss), up to `deadEnds` spurs, up to deadEndMax long, seed = the first floor (?seed=N in the lab's URL overrides; the N key = next floor), reveal = how many cells around the knight the map uncovers. light: party = the knight's own torch (rides with the camera), torch = the wall torches (pool = how many of the nearest are lit; intensities in candela), lair = the dim red light before each of the `pool` nearest enemies still standing (`ahead` metres toward the knight), ambient = the hemisphere fill that gives the shadows their olive tone. paint = the ink-and-paint post pass (after Darkest Dungeon 2 and assets/bg/castle_dungeon.jpg), graded in display space: edge = ink outline strength, edgeWidth in pixels, bands = light steps (bandMix how strongly), desat, inkBelow = brightness under which shadows turn to hatched ink, shadow/highlight = tints of the dark and lit values. decor.torchSpacing = minimum distance between wall torches, in cells. billboard = the enemies standing in the rooms: sizes per enemy id (height in metres, lift = hovers that high), tear = how much of the portrait's cropped bottom is torn away, shadow = opacity of the shadow at its feet, glow = its own light (share of the art shown unlit). paint.fightDim = how far the dungeon darkens behind a fight. decor (0.142): haloSize / haloOpacity = the torches' glow, rubble / puddles = chance per cell, chainsPerRoom = at most, altarLight = the shrine altar's light (x a torch's). mist = ground mist: perCell chance, size and height in metres, opacity, drift speed. tiers = one per depth (the last repeats): name, fog / sky / ground (hemisphere fill) / mist / shadow (the paint pass's shadow tint) colours, palette for the painted textures: stone / floor / ceiling = [hue, hue spread, saturation, spread, lightness, spread], growth = [hue, spread] of moss at the wall foot (null: none), dark = the joints, water = puddles. stairs (0.144) = the way down past the boss: depth of the pit, steps, the light from below (candela, reach, pulses per second; its colour is the NEXT tier's `glow`), the glow sprite over the pit, walkSecs = the walk down into the dark. shadows (0.145) = how many of the nearest lights cast shadows (0 = none), cube map size, bias, redraw every N frames. paint.haze = how much light the air scatters (the glow around every source), hazeReach = metres it reaches. themes (0.146) = what each room can be: height (ceiling, metres), vault + rise (a pointed vault that much higher), pillars, chains (at most, from the ceiling), minSide (cells: the smallest room it fits), fill (0.146: the room's soft bounce light, x a torch, baked only); the start is always the antechamber, the shrine the sanctum, the boss hall the throne room; tiers[].themes = the weights of the others at that depth (never the same theme twice in a row, mostly). sources (0.146) = the room light sources' strength (x a torch's): a candle cluster, an oil lamp, a chandelier, a brazier, a hearth, a window, a cauldron. corridor (0.146) = chances per corridor wall face (banner, door, grate, niche, cobweb) and per corridor cell (bones, drain). quality (0.145) = the lab's frame-rate keeper: under minFps for `seconds`, step down once (shadows off, then resolution x0.75 down to minScale). field (0.146) = the baked light map: every source's light over the floor plan (texelsPerCell, sampled at `height` metres, out to reach x its own reach, soften = metres² added under the distance², strength = how much of it the surfaces take); dynamic = the pool's near lights on top: full within `near` metres, gone by `far`, `share` of a source's strength, a newcomer takes a light only if the held one pulls under `swap` x its pull, rampSecs to light up. 0.147: field.bounce = one bounce of light over the open floor (strength, reach in cells, blur passes; tinted by the tier's stone). ao = the props' baked contact shadows: floor (darkest at the floor) reaching floorReach metres up, wall (darkest at a wall) reaching wallReach metres out. post = the post stack: bloom (threshold and soft knee in scene light, strength, levels of blur), ssao (radius metres, bias, strength 0..1), grade = the colour-grade table (lift / gamma / gain per channel, contrast, saturation); tiers[].grade overrides it per depth. atmosphere = particles per emitter: dust (in window beams), ember, smoke — count, speed (cycles per second), travel (metres), size (metres), maxPx (the largest a particle draws, pixels), colour. post.highlightWhite = how far the brightest colours bleach toward white (0 = not at all). backdrop (0.148) = the game's painted room behind a fight: fadeInSecs / fadeOutSecs, shrine = the shrine too, paintings = the assets/bg/ painting for each room theme (with its depth map, swaying like the game's backgrounds). render.maxLight (0.149) = the brightest light a surface may give off (and the bloom and the paint pass read): a glossy highlight past what the half-float scene target holds turned into flickering black blocks on Apple GPUs. run (0.150) = the game's 3D corridors (?debug 3D CORRIDORS): gen = what a run's floor changes in gen (very linear: no spurs, short corridors), walkSpeed (m/s) and skipSpeed (x, Space / click), ease = metres to reach full pace and to stop, stride = metres per step (head bob `bob` metres), lookAhead = metres ahead the knight looks, turnRate = how fast he turns toward it (per second), round = corner curve (cells), turnSecs = the last turn to the enemy, fadeInSecs / fadeOutSecs = the dungeon over the painting, blackSecs = a new floor out of the dark, vanishSecs = a beaten enemy fading away.
